FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Everything estimators and principals ask before putting Ruh on a real bid: accuracy, review, formats, and the tools you already run.

What is Ruh AI?

Ruh AI is an AI construction workforce for takeoffs and estimating: agents measure quantities off your real drawing sets, price them, and fill your own workbook and proposal templates, while your estimator reviews and signs every line. It works with the tools you already run, including Procore, Bluebeam, QuickBooks, Sage, and Excel.

Does the AI replace my estimator?

No. It does the measuring, pricing, and assembly work; your estimator reviews and signs every line. Every quantity carries a confidence score and a link back to the drawing it came from.

What do I actually get from a takeoff run?

Quantities with per-item verification confidence, a page coverage score, a priced estimate, and exports that fill your own workbook and proposal templates. Not a lookalike format, your format.

How accurate is it?

Every number is labeled measured, derived, or assumed, and partial runs finish honestly as partial. You see exactly how much of the bid is measured versus allowance before you send it.

What plans does it read?

Real drawing PDFs and CAD or DXF files: sheet classification, room areas, count symbols, and scale calibration, the way an estimator reads a set.

Does it work with the tools we already use?

Ruh wraps your stack instead of replacing it. Procore, Bluebeam, QuickBooks, Sage, and Excel workflows are supported, with deeper integrations rolling out.

How fast can we start?

Send one drawing set and see your first AI takeoff on a walkthrough call. Teams typically go live in about a week.

Run your next bid on Ruh.

Send one drawing set. We run the takeoff and walk you through the result on a 30 minute call. If it does not hold up against your estimator, you have lost nothing.
